title: Detailed pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x='28' y='22' width='44' height='18' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='28' y='24' width='44' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFE07A'/>
  <rect x='28' y='34' width='44' height='4' rx='1' fill='#E0A82E'/>
  <!-- pencil top highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='3' height='18' rx='1' fill='#FFF2C0'/>
  <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
  <rect x='28' y='38' width='44' height='7' rx='1' fill='#C0C8D0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='39' width='44' height='2' fill='#E8EEF4'/>
  <rect x='28' y='42' width='44' height='1' fill='#98A4B0'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='44' height='12' rx='4' fill='#F58A9B'/>
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='44' height='4' rx='3' fill='#FFB3BE'/>
  <!-- sharpened tip -->
  <polygon points='28,57 28,68 72,68 72,57' fill='#F0C98A'/>
  <polygon points='28,57 28,68 30,68 30,57' fill='#D4A96A'/>
  <!-- wooden sharpened area shading -->
  <polygon points='28,68 30,68 46,68 28,57' fill='#D4A96A'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='28,68 28,82 70,82 70,68' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <polygon points='28,68 28,82 30,82 30,68' fill='#6A6A8A'/>
  <!-- graphite point -->
  <polygon points='28,82 28,90 68,82 70,82 70,68' fill='#3A3A5A'/>
  <polygon points='28,82 28,90 30,90 30,82' fill='#5A5A7A'/>
  <!-- point highlight -->
  <polygon points='28,84 28,89 32,88 32,84' fill='#8080A0'/>
  <!-- decorative sparkle -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='20' r='3' fill='#FFE07A'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='28' r='2' fill='#F58A9B'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#FFE07A'/>
</svg>
